evidence: Loads the 32-bit identifier through the pointer at input+0x38, passes it to the object stored at global 0x7004650998 via f_700181a6bc, then tail-calls convert_attribute_value_to_float_div_100 with the lookup result. A caller passes an attribute-related record and uses the returned floating value in a larger attribute computation; the exact domain field is left unspecified. decompiled/main/main_0025.c:33962-33977; decompiled/main/main_0013.c:15883-15889; decompiled/main/main_0169.c:28220-28238; decompiled/main/main_0007.c:45237-45238.

Queries attribute-context selector 0 and returns true exactly when its low-byte result equals 8 or 3; other values return false. The caller consumes it as a predicate in an attribute-context path. decompiled/main/main_0006.c:33547-33560; decompiled/main/main_0012.c:43784-43785.

Returns -2 when the input enable byte at +0x428 or required provider data is absent. Otherwise gets nested attribute 0x54 through the explicit provider at input+8 or a fallback provider, then passes the float to a classifier that returns codes 0x17 through 0x1a according to thresholds. The caller stores the returned code in a local result slot. decompiled/main/main_0116.c:5609-5632; decompiled/main/main_0116.c:5634-5670; decompiled/main/main_0113.c:29365-29368.

Queries selector 0x14 (status 20). If its low byte is not 4, returns -2. With status 4, maps a negative input to -2, values 0..4 to themselves, and any value above 4 to 5. Caller uses the result as a derived code in an attribute calculation. decompiled/main/main_0093.c:50148-50170; decompiled/main/main_0119.c:37986-37987.
